title: Mr. Bones
overview:
The immortal DaGoulian has discovered Skeletism, a rhythm-driven power that raises the dead, and has summoned an army of red-eyed skeletons to ravage the world. Only Mr. Bones, a skeleton brought to life by good, blue Skeletism, can stop him.

Each stage plays differently, mixing platform action, rhythm challenges and other surprises across two discs. Fire plasma beams to turn evil skeletons good, and watch your Skeletism: take too much damage and Mr. Bones starts losing body parts, so you must gather and reassemble his bones to keep going. You can even rearrange his limbs to reach new places, and in the Guitar Solo stage you play along to win over a skeleton crowd.

- Stages such as Grave Escape, Mausoleum, Guitar Solo, Underwater Ride and The Icy Lake
- Rock soundtrack composed and performed by Ronnie Montrose
- 1 player, memory backup
